name: 灰鶴
illustrationTaxon: Grus grus adult; monotypic per source. Juvenile is paler, browner, with a plain buff-tinged head and no red crown, and is not shown here.

similarSpecies.distinction: 全身白羽、臉部大片紅色裸皮、嘴淡粉；本種體羽灰、頭頸黑而頸側有白紋、紅斑只在頭頂。
身體白色、頸黑、三級飛羽黑成明顯黑尾塊；本種全身灰，無白色身體與黑色尾塊對比。

featureNotes: 黑色臉部及前頸，配由眼後沿頸側延伸的白色條紋，嘴長而偏淡黃（第1圈實際可見）。
頭頂裸露的紅色皮膚，只限頭頂一小片，臉頰及頸側為白色（第2圈實際可見）。
背及覆羽呈灰褐色，長而蓬鬆的三級飛羽垂在折翼後緣（第3圈實際可見；折翼狀態，飛行時翼羽偏黑，本圈不代表飛行翼色）。
暗灰黑色長腿及長趾（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

rangeMap.note: Country overview only: source describes breeding from Scandinavia and eastern Europe east across Eurasia to northeast Siberia, wintering south to southwest Europe, north and northeast Africa, the Middle East, the northern Indian subcontinent and south China, with China's breeding birds in the northwest and northeast and wintering along the Yellow and Yangtze floodplains. Seasons are not separated on the card.

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: 95-120cm, largely grey crane with black face and fore neck contrasting white rear face and hind neck, red crown, browner mantle and long bulky tertials beyond the wings, blackish flight feathers in flight; juvenile paler/browner with plain buff-tinged head; monotypic; breeding Scandinavia/eastern Europe to northeast Siberia, wintering southwest Europe, north and northeast Africa, Middle East, northern Indian subcontinent and south China; LC, increasing.
Siberian Crane comparison text (all-white adult, red face, black primaries only in flight).
Runtime Chinese name 灰鶴 unchanged.
